entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I, um, I hope you can help. I need to return something. It's a helmet I bought a few weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's for Sarah Jenkins, order number 788-01B. I just... I feel terrible about this. I've been a loyal customer for years.
Thank you, Sarah. I see the order for the Urban Commuter Helmet. I understand you want to make a return. Can I ask, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's just a preference. There's nothing wrong with the helmet itself. Honestly, the color just wasn't what I expected when it arrived, and... well, things are a bit tight right now. I really needed that money for something else. I haven't even opened it, the box is unopened, still sealed and everything.
I see. It looks like this was delivered about 29 days ago. Let me just pull up our current policy for you. One moment.
Oh, has it been that long? I'm so sorry. I hope it's not too late. I was really counting on this...
Not a problem at all, Sarah. I've checked here, and you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. That is such a huge relief. You have no idea. Thank you so much, Charlie.

You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy. Your safety is our top priority, so even if this specific helmet wasn't right, we want you to have gear you love. I've just emailed you a prepaid return label. Just attach that to the package and drop it off at any post office.
I see it in my inbox now. This is perfect. Thank you again for being so understanding.
My pleasure. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been a great help.
Glad I could help, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
